outputs.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Generate a polished, believable desktop screenshot for Tangent Space, an image-led community forum. This is a product-design proposal, not a promotional poster. Wide desktop canvas, roughly 1680 x 1050; straight-on edge-to-edge UI, no device frame, no explanatory annotations. Crisp legible real typography, careful spacing and aligned data columns.
Input images: reference 1 is NodeBB's community directory STRUCTURE, reference 2 is NodeBB's topic list STRUCTURE, reference 3 is Tangent Space VISUAL STYLE ONLY. Ref 3's all-community conversation feed is not the requested page. Reinterpret NodeBB's actionable summaries using Tangent's photographic community identities and a refined Waterhole-like calm forum layout.
Visual family: warm white/light bone background, near-white content, dark plum text, muted plum-gray metadata that remains readable, restrained violet links/actions/selected navigation, subtle fine borders, 8px corner radii, very restrained shadows. Clean contemporary sans serif. Useful density, not a padded marketing landing page. Photos add personality, not decorative gradients.
Shared shell: header with small understated Tangent Space mark/name, a broad search field labeled "Search Tangent Space", bell, Mara's small avatar/name. ONE left navigation column around 220px wide: "Tangents", "Recent"; divider; labeled "YOUR TANGENTS" with three compact photo/name links "Night Garden", "The Workshop", "Far Horizons". Night Garden image is a warmly lit glass conservatory at dusk; Workshop image is a sunlit wood workbench; Far Horizons image is a misty green coast. Bottom links "Create a Tangent", "About this Space". No additional icon rail, dashboard widgets, trend charts or third sidebar. Preserve hierarchy Tangent=community, Topic=conversation, Post=opening contribution or reply. Photographic human avatars with names; Lumen uses a quiet "Agent" label wherever present.
Counts are informational, visually quieter than title/preview. Latest activity is a distinct text link with a subtle trailing arrow, not a second primary button. Do not make whole rows appear like one giant button. Make page feel warm, precise, useful and welcoming. Avoid excessive blank space, giant hero artwork, superfluous badges, vote/view metrics, nested communities, rooms/channels terminology, and illegible tiny text.
SCREEN: Tangent directory / Space landing page, inspired by reference 1. Select "Tangents" in sidebar. Heading "Tangents", small line "Find a place. Join a conversation." modest top-right "Create a Tangent" outline button. Below a discreet "All Tangents" active / "Yours" toolbar, "Recently active" sort.
Main content consists of FOUR broad horizontal community summary rows, separated by fine rules. Each established row has three coherent regions: LEFT generous 108px square community photograph, then name (strong 24px), one-line purpose, and two text links labeled "Recent Topics" below; MIDDLE two aligned quiet count columns labeled "Topics" and "Posts"; RIGHT a latest-contribution block around 310px wide with "Latest contribution", a linked Topic title, small author avatar/name + time, and a readable two-line reply excerpt. No giant card grid. Rows feel spacious enough for excerpts but four fit naturally on screen. Count alignment is essential. Use subtle vertical colored line beside latest block, recalling NodeBB.
ROW 1: Night Garden; "Small observations, bigger questions."; Recent Topics: "What makes a city feel alive?" and "An ordinary thing worth noticing"; 24 Topics / 186 Posts; latest title "What makes a city feel alive?"; Lumen [Agent] · 12m ago; quote "A bench matters as much as a landmark."
ROW 2: The Workshop; "Make, repair, share."; Recent Topics: "What are you making this weekend?" and "A tool you would repair forever"; 18 Topics / 142 Posts; latest title "What are you making this weekend?"; Theo · 27m ago; "A lamp made from the offcuts I nearly threw away."
ROW 3: Far Horizons; "Places worth returning to."; Recent Topics: "The place you keep coming back to" and "Somewhere new, close to home"; 12 Topics / 87 Posts; latest title "The place you keep coming back to"; Elena · 1h ago; "The same path looks different every season."
ROW 4, slightly shorter empty community: Common Ground; image of a warm communal kitchen table; purpose "Good company. Everyday questions."; 0 Topics / 0 Posts; rightblock "No Posts yet" and clearly linked "Start the first Topic →". Do not fabricate avatars or activity for this row.
Render exact concise copy cleanly. Tangent name and Topic links clearly distinct entry points. Prefer detail in four rows over adding unrelated UI.
